subject: Mutual runway & acceptance timeline — SummitGrid onboarding
messages:
From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@summitgrid.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@summitgrid.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual runway & acceptance timeline — SummitGrid onboarding

Marissa / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — SummitGrid is excited to move toward a pilot. To get the procurement and engineering teams aligned, can you share a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates, owners, and explicit acceptance criteria for each phase? Our procurement lead (Lydia) asked for a high-level timeline to include in the PO and internal kickoff invitation.

A couple of constraints on our side:
- Target production pilot window: mid-Jan to early Feb (preferred)
- Security review complete by 12/20/2026 (SOC 2 evidence already underway)
- We need a compatibility checklist for our SSO and VPC connectivity up front

I've attached a short kickoff brief (SummitGrid_kickoff_notes.docx) with our preferred time windows and internal stakeholders. Appreciate a MAP draft by end of day Friday so we can route the PO.

Thanks,
Ethan Shaw
VP Product, SummitGrid Analytics
E: ethan.shaw@summitgrid.com
T: +1 206-555-0142

Attachments: SummitGrid_kickoff_notes.docx (docx)
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@summitgrid.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual runway & acceptance timeline — SummitGrid onboarding

Hi Ethan — thanks for the kickoff brief, and welcome — excited to partner on this.

Attached is a first-pass MAP (SummitGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level summary below; the workbook has the milestone owners, acceptance criteria, and a short riser for each dependency.

90-day MAP summary (proposed):
1) Week 0 — Kickoff & readiness (11/23–11/29)
   - Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Lydia (SummitGrid)
   - Deliverables: Kickoff slide deck; access inventory; SSO metadata exchange
   - Acceptance: Connectivity checklist completed and signed off by SummitGrid infra

2) Week 1–3 — Staging integration (11/30–12/20)
   - Owner: Ben (Redwood) / SummitGrid infra lead
   - Deliverables: VPC peering or private link setup; test corpus transfer; baseline latency report
   - Acceptance: Test pass for SSO auth and model inference on staging (>=95% of test prompts succeed)

3) Week 4–6 — Pilot validation (01/04–01/24)
   - Owner: Monica (Redwood) / SummitGrid product
   - Deliverables: Pilot dataset runs; quality evaluation report; cost/billing estimation run
   - Acceptance: Pilot KPIs met (response time median <250ms, quality QPS as agreed), no critical issues

4) Week 7–12 — Production cutover prep & go-live window (01/25–02/28)
   - Owner: Ben / SummitGrid ops
   - Deliverables: Runbooks; rollback plan; SLA confirmation; final procurement paperwork
   - Acceptance: Production readiness checklist complete; signed acceptance form and PO received

Key notes & contingencies:
- Security evidence: we'll provide SOC2 artifacts and an audit log export template by 11/20 to help your security review.
- Cutover weekend: we recommend a staged cutover over a weekend (Sat–Sun) with a warm standby for first 48 hours.
- Fallback: automatic routing to a lower-capacity replica in case of load or latency spikes.

Action items (from Redwood):
- Marissa: finalize MAP spreadsheet and circulate (today) — DONE (attached)
- Ben: draft staging runbook and sizing estimates (due 11/17)
- Monica: coordinate pilot success criteria and create eval prompt set (due 12/10)

Ethan/Lydia — if this aligns, we'll update dates to match your procurement and lock the kickoff week. Happy to jump on a short call tomorrow if you want to walk through the MAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: SummitGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 11:02 AM marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> 3) Week 4–6 — Pilot validation (01/04–01/24)
>    - Deliverables: Pilot dataset runs; quality evaluation report; cost/billing estimation run
>    - Acceptance: Pilot KPIs met (response time median <250ms, quality QPS as agreed), no critical issues

Quick note — for the production cutover window, does SummitGrid have any blackout dates in Jan/Feb? If you plan to target mid-Jan, we should reserve two potential consecutive weekends (primary + fallback) to minimize customer impact. Also, depending on dataset size we may need an additional staging window for bulk imports (I can size this after I see the dataset sample).

I'll start the staging runbook draft and include a bulk-import checklist. Marissa — I'll send a runbook link by 11/17 as noted.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Shaw <ethan.shaw@summitgrid.com>

Marissa / Ben / Monica — this looks great, thanks for the fast turnaround. We reviewed the MAP internally and can confirm:
- Security review target (12/20) is workable if we receive SOC2 artifacts and audit-log template by 11/20.
- Pilot window: we can target 01/11–01/24 as primary pilot dates, with cutover weekend of 01/30–01/31 as preferred go-live.
- Procurement: our finance team will issue the PO this week referencing deal SG-2026-1427. Attaching PO-7890.pdf to this thread for your records.

Next steps:
- Lydia will send a calendar invite for kickoff (proposed 11/23 at 10:00 PST).
- Ben — please share the staging runbook link; we'll provide a dataset sample by 11/18.
- Monica — we'll review the evaluation prompt set and send any initial feedback by 12/01.

Thanks again — we consider this aligned. Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Ethan Shaw
VP Product, SummitGrid Analytics
